review_description: Excellent customer service from start to finish including post installation. Very professional, available and knowledgeable. Anker battery working beautifully so far. Very happy

I found the staff at ECO Sparks to be very professional in all their dealings. From going back and forth with Lloyd close to 6 months on a best possible solution to Anthony and the team completing a professional installation. Assistance provided with going through all requirements for applicable rebates and building permits. All questions were answered, and the new system was explained thoroughly. Thanks to all and would recommend your services.
I ended up with just the 6.6kw system, no battery.  Installation went smoothly and electrician was exceptionally neat and tidy with the installation of the inverter.
Everything went as expected, would recommend to everyone. Nothing at all to complain about.

The sales and quoting process was well-explained, especially the complicated government stuff.The installation took place very soon after the quote acceptance. It was also a rapidly completed job, and the crew were friendly during the work and cleaned up well when the task was completed.The after-sales service was first-class and appears to be ongoing.

Upside:100% satisfied with the solar + battery system by the boys of Eco Sparks.Even from months prior e installation, Lloyd has been providing information, quote, and suggestions about the recommended specifications. I'm a data freak and can confirm that his recommendation aligned with my own research / calculations.They installed everything within 1 day, made a lot of mess, then cleaned up after themselves, leaving the premise clean.The system itself works exceptionally well, to the point of my meter stopped moving and been 100% self-sufficient so far. Only time will tell.However, with 10 years warranty on the battery and inverter, and 25 on the panels. Hopefully the investment will pay itself before it shat itself. :)Downside :They supposed to do the installation from 8.30am, instead they rocked up at 7.30am. :DCheers.

We just had our Solar panels installed by Eco Sparks in Darwin and we had a great experience. Our representative Lloyd was easy going and not pushy like other reps we had previously dealt with. He explained the whole process in a way my husband and I could understand, he answered all our questions even if they seemed silly to us and even after the panels were installed he still followed up and kept in touch with any queries we may have had. He even got us approved and ready for install all in the same week! Even though we were told it could be a few weeks due to high demand. On the day of installation the Eco Sparks team arrived on time and the work done all in one day and in a professional manner. We had spoken to a few companies and found Eco Sparks, for quality and affordability to be the best option for us. Thank you to Eco Sparks for a seamless experience. We highly recommend Lloyd and the Eco Sparks team if you are looking to have Solar installed in the Darwin area.

The team were very helpful, provided all available options and knew all requirements for our home. Thanks to Lloyd, Anthony and Manoli, we are very satisfied to have Solar promptly installed to save energy costs and use renewable sources of energy.

The sales/quoting process with Lloyd was very friendly and engaging.The installation was done very efficiently and tidily. The battery placement was an issue for car access, but they have looked at an alternative site and will re-position.The customer service has been good and with some problems connecting to the grid, they have kept us informed along the way.

From start to finish the process was easy.Ecosparks was not pushy, but matter of fact. from the first interaction I knew they would win my work. they didn't try and oversell, just listened to my needs and worked through options and didn't try to sell one system or brand over another but gave opinions on pros and cons, which pretty much aligned with the research I had done myself. and they didn't disappoint when I chose them to progress. They helped me through the battery grant process, updated on any changes, kept me informed of installation date, any changes to products they were intending to use, accommodated my requests on where the battery and inverter was installed, and did a pretty good job of tidying up as they went along. the team were all pretty polite and courteous.I would definitely recommend.

A big thumbs-up to the Eco Sparks team (lead by Anthony) for the fantastic solar system installation they completed in Zuccoli. These guys are like a well-oiled machine! They arrived right on time and didn't waste a second getting to work. Even with some windy conditions, they didn't cut corners. It's clear they take pride in their work and want things done right. They kept me in the loop at every step and I couldn't be happier with the whole experience. The setup is sleek and clean, no nonsense, no fuss, just solid work and great people. Excellent customer service and follow up was also on point!

Everything has been great the Solar is up and running, we set aside an amount of money for the installation however if anyone is doing an installation allow for a month from contacting eco sparks for work to start, this is due to getting building approvals and other stuff.

Sales and quoting process was super easy, they didn’t humbug for a decision like some installers…One issue we had was some damage to the garage roof which was fixed within a week. There was also no handover post installation as the install date was delayed to a day that I was working. Customer service was otherwise ok.

I am very happy with the service of Lloyd and the crew at Eco Sparks who installed our solar and battery system.  Lloyd was very attentive, nothing was too much trouble in terms of answering all of my questions or requesting a certain type of solar panel which I preferred.  The quote was very competitive with others I received.  Installation went very smoothly, everything was done in a day, and the team left the place clean and tidy. Helped organise all connections and new meter box.  Post install service was great too with Lloyd calling to check if there were any problems and checking on first power bills to ensure app and everything was working as it should.   It's been 4 months and no issues.  My power bill is now only 1/4 of what it was !  Would highly recommend Eco Sparks (and have done so to my friends). Ps. Thanks for all of the very useful information solarquotes.
All installation was good, but they didn't gave me access to inverter and it has connect to internet.

Eco Sparks a Darwin electrical contractor recently installed a solar with battery system at our home. The workmanship was excellent as was the communication with us throughout and post installation.I highly recommend them.

Eco Sparks are a professional accredited company that have a range of solar installation plans. The sales person Lloyd is a great communicator and helped me understand my power usage currently and the best options for my home energy needs. This included a home assessment, Jacana assessment and the optimal energy possible with solar and how it works. They even helped me fill in the solar grant form! Great Team, reliable, responsive and professional. Instillation was smooth, timely a well supported Team, great guys! I recommend Eco Sparks for Solar and electrical!

Very happy with the whole process- communication was great and done via email or phone which was convenient. Short wait time, efficient on the day, and took care of all the details making it very easy!
The company was great and provided all the information and quotes needed. Also installed and obtained all connections and certificates.
The guys from Eco Sparks did a great job at explaining the system to me. They were very easy to deal with and Iâ€™m very happy to recommend them.

When I first met with eco sparks' sales rep Alex I felt very comfortable and well informed of the process. There were no mistakes and it was a smooth process from start to finish. Highly recommend them for their service and workmanship!

Eco Sparks went to great lengths to explain their products and their process. The result was a friendly and professional installation, a great finish and a good follow up process. I am really happy that I chose Eco Sparks and would highly recommend them to anyone wanting to install a system.

Friendly knowledgeable sales person and not pushy. He was happy to give multiple competitive quotes for different options I was interested in. Installation was fast, the team turned up on time, did a neat install, put the inverter where I wanted it and didnâ€™t leave any mess.

The sales quoting process was clear and well explained.The installation was undertaken efficiently & tradesmen were polite and helpful.  Very tidy job.The customer service was excellent and any/all queries and concerns dealt with politely and efficiently.  The after service with attention to assist with the grid connection, etc was excellent.

Communication with this company was easy and always accurate, delivered when promised, installed professionally and after sales has been exceptional whilst ironing out the bugs with the software and registration. Highly recommend this local company.
